messages:
docs-nina: Quick docs bug: GET /v1/requests returns example body as an array of request objects, but runtime wraps results in an object `{ total, items }`. Also examples show `request_id` snake_case while API uses `id`.
eng-omar: yep that changed when we paginated results. Server now returns:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "total": 42,
  "items": [ { "id": "req-01", "status": "succeeded" }, ... ]
}
```
docs-nina: thanks. I'll update the docs example and the OpenAPI example to match the object envelope.
sdk-zoe: our SDK list helper expects an array; this mismatch caused a few bug reports. Please add a migration note so we can update SDKs and give customers time to adapt.
docs-nina: plan: change example->object envelope, add short migration callout: "List endpoints now return `{ total, items }` instead of a raw array. Update client parsers accordingly; SDKs will accept both shapes for one release." I'll also add an example of iterating items in both JS and curl.
pm-luke: add a link to the API changelog and note the date of change. Enterprise teams will want to know when this landed.
docs-nina: will include changelog link and tag @sdk-zoe. PR #5099 created.
lint-bot: docs lint: example response schema missing `total` description (warning).
docs-nina: will add schema description and label the example "common response" and include the legacy array example under a bolded migration section.
eng-omar: also file a small infra ticket to scan other list endpoints for envelope vs array mismatches.
sdk-zoe: thanks — will coordinate a minor SDK patch to accept both shapes and add a deprecation warning in logs for the raw-array shape.
deploy-bot: PR #5099 (docs): List endpoint example updated  awaiting review :eyes:
docs-nina: pinging for quick reviews; small change but high impact for customers.
